claims.quote: Long-acting muscarinic antagonists are a reasonable alternative as first-line therapy for patients with COPD.

claims.text: LAMAs (with LABAs and ICS) reduce exacerbation frequency, but no bronchodilator is proven to slow lung-function decline.
claims.quote: The frequency of exacerbations can be reduced with the use of anticholinergics, long-acting beta-agonists, and inhaled corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). However, there is no convincing evidence that regular bronchodilator use slows deterioration of lung function.

claims.text: Umeclidinium (Incruse Ellipta, COPD): 1 actuation (62.5 mcg) once daily, same time each day; not more than once in 24 h.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of INCRUSE ELLIPTA for maintenance treatment of COPD is 1 actuation (umeclidinium 62.5 mcg) once daily by oral inhalation. • INCRUSE ELLIPTA should be used at the same time every day. Do not use INCRUSE ELLIPTA more than 1 time every 24 hours.

claims.text: Stiolto: a LABA without an ICS is contraindicated in asthma; not indicated for asthma.
claims.quote: Use of a LABA, including STIOLTO RESPIMAT, without an inhaled corticosteroid is contraindicated in patients with asthma [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . STIOLTO RESPIMAT is not indicated for the treatment of asthma.

claims.text: Maintenance only, not a rescue inhaler; don't start in acutely deteriorating COPD.
claims.quote: • Do not initiate in acutely deteriorating COPD. Do not use to treat acute symptoms. ( 5.1 )

claims.text: Use a rapid-acting beta-2 agonist for acute symptoms.
claims.quote: In the event of an acute attack, a rapid-acting beta 2 -agonist should be used.

claims.text: Caution: narrow-angle glaucoma; prostatic hyperplasia or bladder-neck obstruction (urinary retention);
claims.quote: Worsening of narrow-angle glaucoma may occur. Use with caution in patients with narrow-angle glaucoma and instruct patients to consult a physician immediately if this occurs. ( 5.4 ) Worsening of urinary retention may occur. Use with caution in patients with prostatic hyperplasia or bladder-neck obstruction and instruct patient to consult a physician immediately if this occurs. ( 5.5 )

claims.text: stop if paradoxical bronchospasm or immediate hypersensitivity occurs.
claims.quote: Paradoxical bronchospasm: Discontinue SPIRIVA RESPIMAT and consider other treatments if paradoxical bronchospasm occurs. ( 5.3 )

claims.text: All anticholinergics: pupillary dilation (can trigger or worsen acute angle-closure glaucoma), urinary retention, dry mouth.
claims.quote: Adverse effects of all anticholinergics are pupillary dilation (and risk of triggering or worsening acute angle-closure glaucoma), urinary retention, and dry mouth.

claims.text: Other anticholinergic drugs: additive adverse effects; avoid the combination.
claims.quote: There is potential for an additive interaction with concomitantly used anticholinergic medications. Therefore, avoid coadministration of SPIRIVA RESPIMAT with other anticholinergic-containing drugs as this may lead to an increase in anticholinergic adverse effects

claims.text: Tiotropium is renally excreted: with CrCl < 60 mL/min, monitor closely for anticholinergic side effects.
claims.quote: As a predominantly renally excreted drug, patients with moderate to severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance of <60 mL/min) treated with SPIRIVA RESPIMAT should be monitored closely for anticholinergic side effects

claims.text: Overdose: high doses may cause anticholinergic signs;
claims.quote: High doses of tiotropium may lead to anticholinergic signs and symptoms.

claims.text: stop the drug and give symptomatic/supportive care.
claims.quote: Treatment of overdosage consists of discontinuation of SPIRIVA RESPIMAT together with institution of appropriate symptomatic and/or supportive therapy.
